subject: Business Studies
central_question: How do general management principles and the contributions of Taylor and Fayol guide efficient and responsible managerial action?
in_scope_units: Meaning, nature and significance of principles
Comparison and relevance of Taylor and Fayol

known_pitfalls.correction: They are flexible guidelines applied according to the situation.

known_pitfalls.claim: Unity of command and unity of direction are identical.
known_pitfalls.correction: Unity of command concerns one boss; unity of direction concerns one head and one plan for the same objective.
Taylor also stressed scientific study, cooperation, selection, training and standardisation.

ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: Exercises contain Very Short Answer questions 1-6, Short Answer questions 1-6 and Long Answer/Essay questions 1-7.
